messages:
omar: Heads-up — payments flagged a chargeback on acct_987654 for $12,300 (customer says 'unauthorized refund'). We show a refund was issued on 2026-03-16. Need evidence packet + recommendation to hold.
billing-bot: Chargeback created — CB12345678 for txn `T20260315-9f7` — reason: fraud — dispute window ends 2026-05-30. Filing ID: 0x4b2a
lisa: can someone paste the txn + refund request payload? IP/user agent would help.
franklin: quick paste of the records we have:
`TRANSACTION` txn_id=T20260315-9f7
AMOUNT=$12,300
CARD=**** **** **** 4242
CUSTOMER=acct_987654
ORDER=order_99012
REFUND=refund_id=R20260316-11a
API_CALL=POST /v1/refunds {"charge":"T20260315-9f7","reason":"requested_by_customer"}
ORIGIN_IP=198.51.100.23
USER_AGENT=Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36
API_KEY_OWNER=billing-sync (key_id: key_live_abc123)
NOTES=refund issued via partner integration, webhook delivered status=200

sophie: FYI that `billing-sync` integration belongs to partner Clearship. They rotated keys around 2026-03-14 in their dashboard.
omar: can infra confirm IP geolocation + see if the device matches prior logins? also check whether refund flow required any extra auth.
franklin: IP geo -> Toronto, ON (matches some prior activity). Device UA matches previous patterns. Refund was initiated server-side with an integrator key so no MFA prompt was recorded in our logs for that flow.
lisa: I'm going to pull console access audit (who accessed acct_987654 in the 24h window) and webhook delivery logs. If partner rotated keys on 3/14 and claim is 3/16, we need to confirm compromised key vs partner action.
franklin: evidence checklist I'm attaching inline: transaction log, refund API request/response, webhook payloads, partner integration id, last 3 login email addresses for acct_987654, basic KYC snapshot (business name on file), and billing email chain with customer.
billing-bot: Evidence packet uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evidence/CB12345678 (access: finance-team + disputes). 
omar: Recommendation: place temporary hold on acct_987654 and pause outgoing refunds until partner rotates keys and we validate ownership. @sophie any objections?
sophie: agree. Place hold, open partner security ticket with Clearship, and request immediate key rotation + replay token audit. I'll loop in Legal if customer escalates.
lisa: done — hold placed at 2026-03-18T15:12Z (hold_id HLD-20260318-22). Notifying CS to pause outreach.
omar: thanks everyone. If legal wants copies, use the evidence link above. :thumbsup:
